strings.(쥬리링이 풀밭에 누워 하늘을 바라보고 있는 모험가에게 다가온다.): (Juriring approaches the adventurer, who lies in the grass gazing at the sky.)
You weren't in the village, so I looked for you, ring.
strings.여기서 뭐 해요, 링?: What are you doing here, ring?
Oh, well... Hmm. I'm not sure I should tell you.
Iris says it's all right, ring.
You're coming here, ring? Oh, oooooh...
strings.(쥬리링이 고개를 들자, 어디선가 작은 빛이 흘러와 모험가 앞으로 내려온: (Juriring raises its head. A small light drifts in from somewhere and descends before the adventurer.)
strings.(빛이 사라진 자리에 환한 미소로 모험가와 쥬리링을 바라보는 여성이 서: (Where the light fades, a woman stands smiling brightly at the adventurer and Juriring.)
strings.그런 건 아니에요. 위대한 벽의 복구가 어느 정도 마무리돼서 잠시 한숨: No. The repairs to the great wall have progressed enough that I can take a short breath.
strings.(쥬리링이 이리스 옆으로 다가가 몸을 비비자 이리스가 쥬리링을 쓰다듬는다: (Juriring approaches and rubs against Iris. She strokes it.)
Juriring loves Devesis. I only did what I should, ring.
Iris, eat with us, ring. The chef's food is delicious, ring.
I'm sorry, Juriring. I have something else to do now.
All right, ring. That's a shame, but let's go together next time, ring.
There's something I need to tell you, %s.
This is a request as the God of the Astral Realm, not as Iris. %s, you need to rest for a while.
Rest? You know what's happening. Daphne and Barbatos...
strings.당분간은 제가 그들을 추적할게요. 둘에게 많은 힘이 모여서 이제 일반적인: I'll track them for now. They've gathered so much power that ordinary methods can no longer follow them.
strings.제가 위대한 벽 너머로 그들을 따라갈 거예요. %s, 그동안은 잠시 쉬세: I'll pursue them beyond the great wall. %s, rest in the meantime.
strings.내가 고집을 부리면 강제로라도 쉬게 할 거지?: If I insist, you'll make me rest anyway, won't you?
All right. I'll do as you ask.
strings.그러면 지금 다프네와 바르바토스의 상태가 어떤지 이야기해 줄 수 있어?: Then can you tell me what's happening with Daphne and Barbatos now?
strings.먼저 다프네는 얼마 전을 끝으로 더는 마녀의 목숨을 빼앗지 않는 것 같아: First, Daphne seems to have stopped taking witches' lives since the last time. I don't know what changed her mind.
It's as though she's preparing for the end.
strings.그리고 바르바토스는 신들의 영역으로 갈 준비를 하고 있어요. 그곳이 어디: And Barbatos is preparing to enter the realm of the gods. I don't know where exactly...
But I should be able to follow him soon.
Rest for a little while until then.
strings.만약… 헤카테 님이 다프네 손에 소멸한다면 마녀들은 어떻게 되지?: If... Hecate is destroyed by Daphne, what happens to the witches?
strings.다프네는 원인을 제거하면 끝난다고 믿고 있어요. 그 믿음과는 다른 결과가: Daphne believes removing the cause will end it. Even though she knows the outcome may differ from what she believes...
strings.헤카테 님께서 어떤 생각을 하고 계시는지 모르는 상태에선 제가 할 수 있: Without knowing what Hecate is thinking, there's nothing I can do... Still, I'll try everything I can.
All right. I'll rest, then. Call me when it's time.
strings.너무 오래 기다리게 하지는 않을 거예요. 그럼 이제 가 볼게요. 다음에: I won't keep you waiting too long. I'll go now. See you next time.
strings.(이리스가 모두의 인사를 받으며 다가오는 빛과 함께 자리에서 모습을 감춘: (Iris accepts everyone's farewells and disappears with an approaching light.)
Isn't it a little early? You've been eating more often since sharing meals with Patello.
strings.(쥬리링이 조용히 자신의 배를 들여다본다.): (Juriring quietly looks down at its belly.)
strings.때가 되면 카울리니였던 바르바토스에 대해서 이야기해 준다고 했잖아. 그게: You said you'd tell me about Barbatos, who used to be Kaulini, when the time came. When is that?
I'm not sure, ring. Maybe after you've had a good rest and come back, ring.
strings.(마냥 가만히 있으면 안 될 것 같기는 한데…. 메디아 님은 잘 계신가?: (I don't think I can just sit around... Is Medea doing well? Maybe I'll visit Kali...)
Oh, I forgot Marta was looking for you, ring. Let's go, ring.
strings.(마르타가 눈을 감은 채 앞에 있는 구조물에 손을 올려 두고 있다.): (Marta stands with her eyes closed, resting a hand on the structure before her.)
The world within this structure called Likimo Pelke... It will never open again, but...
I heard you were looking for me.
strings.네. 할 이야기가 있어서 쥬리링에게 어디 있는지 찾아봐 달라고 부탁했습니: Yes. I had something to tell you, so I asked Juriring to find you.
...Said it was hungry and went straight to the Cloud's Threshold.
strings.마침 파텔로도 식사하러 가서 라셀리스가 바쁘겠군요. 안 그래도 파텔로가: Patello went to eat, too. Raselis must be busy. He was asking when he could return to the tower...
strings.아직 모르겠다고 하니까 실망하면서 돌아가는 모습이 안쓰러워서 원…. 라셀: When I said I didn't know yet, he looked so disappointed as he left. I felt sorry for him... I hope Raselis doesn't hate him too much.
strings.마르타 님, 제가 글래스턴으로 가서 알아볼까요?: Marta, shall I go to Glaston and ask?
strings.말씀만으로도 감사합니다. 이미 사람을 보내 알아보고 있으니 신경 쓰지 마: Thank you for offering. I've already sent someone, so please don't worry.
I have some connections. We should get an answer of some kind.
strings.제가 오늘 이렇게 부른 건… 저번에 파텔로 군에게 수인에 관한 전설을 물: The reason I called you today... I heard you asked Patello about a beastkin legend.
strings.전설 속의 수인은 혼돈의 하늘 시절 '눈먼 새의 둥지'로 올라갔고, 그곳: The beastkin in that legend went up to the Blind Bird's Nest during the Sky of Chaos, and must have met a god there.
strings.데베시스의 사람들이 알고 있고, 제가 파텔로 군에게 했던 이야기는 이게: That's all the people of Devesis know, and all I told Patello...
But there was one more thing I saw when I escaped from that spirit twenty-five years ago...
strings.유리 벽 같은 것이 깨지고 제가 원래 세상으로 돌아왔다는 느낌을 받은 순: When something like a glass wall broke, and I felt I'd returned to the ordinary world, I encountered an old memory dwelling there...
I'd forgotten it for so long, but since Likimo Pelke disappeared, it's been returning little by little.
The moment a beastkin named Talos touched a great mirror...
strings.더 말씀드리고 싶지만, 제가 본 건 그게 전부였습니다. 마치 기억의 조각: I wish I could tell you more, but that was all I saw. Like a fragment of memory...
strings.표정을 보니 도움이 된 모양이군요. 혹시 데베시스를 떠나시나요?: Judging by your expression, that helped. Are you leaving Devesis?
No, there's just somewhere I need to visit. Please look after Elliot while I'm gone.
strings.걱정하지 마세요. 슈비에가 살펴보고, 다른 분들도 계속 신경 쓰고 있으니: Don't worry. Shuvie is watching him, and everyone else is keeping an eye on him, too.
strings.그건 그렇고 엘리엇에게 무슨 일이 있었던 걸까요? 본인 말로는 3년 전에: But what could have happened to Elliot? He says he left Linford three years ago...
strings.린포드로 가는 길은 10년 전에 알 수 없는 힘으로 끊겼습니다…. 현재는: The road to Linford was cut off by an unknown force ten years ago... Part of the route from Whispering Hill to Aether Road is blocked by something like a wall of powerful magic.
strings.황실과 의회에서 마법청과 여러 교단을 통해 이 상황을 타개해 보겠다고 했: The imperial family and assembly said they would resolve it through the Magic Bureau and various religious orders, but made little progress...
As time passed, people gradually forgot Linford...
strings.(린포드…. 분명 천계의 조각이 있는 천사의 도시라고 했었지….): (Linford... The city of angels with a fragment of the Celestial Realm...)
I see... I'll hear more from Elliot when I return.
strings.(칼리에는 쉬러 가는 것이니까 이리스가 걱정할 일은 일어나지 않겠지.): (I'm only going to Kali to rest. Nothing that would worry Iris should happen.)
...It's a lovely day, so I was going to have tea outside. You've arrived at just the right time.
strings.(메디아가 살며시 찻잔을 %s에게 내민다.): (Medea gently offers %s a cup of tea.)
strings.…고맙습니다, 메디아 님. 그동안 잘 지내셨어요?: ...Thank you, Medea. Have you been well?
strings.저야 뭐, 린도스를 다녀온 이후로는 힐다와 함께 마을에서 잘 지내고 있습: Since returning from Lindos, I've been living peacefully in the village with Hilda.
Hmm, it smells lovely. Different from the tea we had before.
strings.네. 이오 님께서 게르다에서만 자라는 꽃과 허브를 섞어 티백을 만들어 주: Yes. Io made tea bags from flowers and herbs that grow only in Gerda.
When you first came to the village, I never imagined we'd share tea like this... We truly cannot know what lies ahead.
To think a day would come when the Kali people no longer suffer in Eastland...
strings.이스트랜드를 구한 영웅이 너무 겸손한 거 아냐? 내가 본 것만 해도 몇: Aren't you a little too humble for the hero who saved Eastland? I've seen plenty myself...
strings.어, 힐다…. 언제 왔어?: Oh, Hilda. When did you get here?
strings.지루해서 잠깐 마을 안을 산책했어. 아직 밖으로 나갈 수 없는 거 알잖아: I was bored, so I took a walk around the village. You know I still can't go outside.
strings.아니, 그보다 뭘 어떻게 봤다는 거야? 언제부터 날 알고 있었지?: Wait, what exactly have you seen? How long have you known about me?
strings.흐음…. 네가 이스트랜드를 온 순간부터? 말하자면 길어…. 굳이 이 긴: Hmm... Since you arrived in Eastland? It's a long story... And I don't particularly want to tell it.
strings.그런데 칼리에는 무슨 일이야? 내가 보고 싶어서 온 건 아닐 테고…. 뭐: What brings you to Kali? You didn't come because you missed me... Daphne, I suppose?
strings.힐다, 앉아요. 차 드시겠어요?: Hilda, sit down. Would you like tea?
Quite a bit... I ended up going to a place called Nidaros in Alfheim...
strings.(힐다와 메디아에게 니다로스부터 데베시스까지 있었던 일을 간단하게 이야기: (I briefly tell Hilda and Medea what happened from Nidaros to Devesis.)
strings.(이야기를 듣는 두 사람의 얼굴이 조금씩 굳는다.): (Their expressions gradually stiffen as they listen.)
I'm sorry, Medea. I wanted this to be a pleasant visit.
strings.아니에요. 오히려 말씀해 주셔서 고마워요. 왠지 칼리에 오시게 된 것도: No. Thank you for telling us. Somehow, I feel your coming to Kali may not be a coincidence...
strings.%s…. 그 질문에 대한 답을 제대로 듣고 싶으시겠지만…. 저조차도 알지: %s... I know you want a proper answer to that question... But even I don't know.
strings.마녀의 삶을 내린 헤카테 님께서 다프네의 손에 소멸한다고 해서 마녀들이: I doubt witches will be freed from their lives simply because Daphne destroys Hecate, who imposed those lives on them...
In the worst case, the world's very rules could change...
strings.제일 좋은 방법은 헤카테 님께서 마음을 돌리는 것이겠지만, 그 가능성은: The best solution would be for Hecate to change her mind, but that is extremely unlikely...
And Daphne won't change her mind, either... We'll have to face her eventually...
The item that's nearly finished should help stop Daphne.
Remember what I took from Dmitri in Lindos?
strings.글린다 님께 맡긴다고 했지?: You said you'd leave it with Glinda?
Medea and I went to collect it recently.
strings.그 물건은 어디 있어? 어떻게 사용하면 되는 거야?: Where is it? How do we use it?
strings.조금 더 있어야 하는데, 오래 걸리지는 않을 거야. 그러니까 칼리에서 조: It needs a little longer, but not much. Could you wait in Kali for a while?
Why does it feel like the village is shaking? Don't tell me...
strings.%s…. 죄송하지만, 저희가 식사 준비를 하고 있을 동안 그분을 모셔 오: %s... I'm sorry, but would you bring her here while we prepare the meal?
strings.(베이넌이 바닥에 넘어진 작은 소녀를 빤히 바라본다.): (Beinan stares at the little girl sprawled on the ground.)
You used to help me up. Now you just leave me here. Hmph, no fun.
strings.(베이넌이 샤이닉을 일으켜 세워 먼지를 털어 준다.): (Beinan helps Shynic up and brushes off the dust.)
As I always say, this puts us in a difficult position...
What's difficult? It's not my first visit to Kali.
strings.마력을 조절하지 않고 무작정 달려와서 깨뜨린 결계가 한둘이 아니지 않습니: How many barriers have you broken by rushing here without controlling your magic?!
Medea told me to admit my mistakes quickly.
Using Medea as an excuse... That's low... I mean, understood.
strings.(샤이닉이 모험가를 보자마자 품으로 달려가 안긴다.): (The moment Shynic sees the adventurer, she runs into their arms.)
strings.그동안 놀러 오지도 않고. 나 버리고 다른 대륙 가면 재미있어?: You never came to visit. Is it fun abandoning me for another continent?
People will get the wrong idea.
You're still alive, so I see you've been well.
%s... You've changed a lot. Handling Shynic so smoothly...
I know. When you first came to see me, you were terrified...
strings.아, 시간이…. %s, 샤이닉 님을 부탁한다. 난 아드리카로 순찰을 다녀: Oh, the time... %s, look after Shynic. I need to patrol Adrika...
You seem to have changed a little, too, Beinan.
Have I? I'm glad you think so.
Yes, glad. Enjoy your visit, Shynic.
strings.매번 이렇게 오게 해서 미안해요. 제가 노엘을 볼 겸 타르타로스로 가려고: I'm sorry to keep making you come here. I meant to visit Tartaros and see Noel, too...
strings.괜찮아, 괜찮아. 사정이 있었잖아. 타르타로스에서 칼리가 먼 것도 아니고: It's fine, it's fine. You had your reasons. Kali isn't far from Tartaros. I can just run over ♡
strings.어르신께서 메디아와 사이가 참 좋아 보여서. 이스트랜드에 처음 왔을 때는: You and Medea seem close. When I first came to Eastland, the Transcendents didn't get along.
strings.다 옛날이야기지. 그런데 너! 메디아는 메디아인데 나는 왜 어르신이야?: That's ancient history. But you! Medea gets called Medea, so why am I 'elder'?
strings.내가 꼬맹이 손 좀 봐 줘도 될까? 죽이진 않을게. 죽지 않을 정도로만: May I teach this little brat a lesson? I won't kill her. Just enough to keep her alive ♡
strings.(샤이닉이 힐다를 향해 차가운 미소를 짓자 평화롭던 칼리에 스산한 기운이: (Shynic smiles coldly at Hilda, and a chilling presence sweeps into peaceful Kali.)
strings.샤이닉, 말만 그렇게 하고 더 안 하실 거죠? 힐다도 샤이닉을 그렇게 자: Shynic, you're only saying that, aren't you? Hilda, stop provoking her.
strings.두 분 다 제 소중한 손님이긴 하지만, 칼리 마을에서 소란을 일으킨다면: You're both my valued guests, but if you cause trouble in Kali, I won't stand by...
strings.(메디아가 웃으며 힐다와 샤이닉을 번갈아 바라본다.): (Medea smiles and looks from Hilda to Shynic.)
You're not my family. I'll just use your name.
strings.그런데 힐다, 오늘은 괜찮아?: By the way, Hilda, are you all right today?
I haven't had Medea's help today, but I'm better than expected.
strings.그러고 보니 너희 둘, 영혼의 결이 같았지? 사실 누구 하나 무너져도 이: Come to think of it, your souls have the same texture, don't they? It wouldn't be strange for either of you to collapse...
In the old days, many died that way and went to the Netherworld.
It was an ability I never wanted, but I'm glad it helped Hilda.
Where's Minuet, anyway? I haven't seen her lately.
strings.언제부턴가 아드리카를 벗어날 수 있게 된 것 같아요. 그래서 여행하는 기: It seems she's become able to leave Adrika. She said she's traveling around the continent.
strings.이리스 님께서 맨발로 다니는 미뉴에트가 안타까웠는지 신발도 선물해 주셨다: Atkina told me Iris felt sorry for Minuet walking barefoot and gave her shoes.
As long as she's well, I'm glad.
Shynic, I have a favor to ask...
strings.말만 해. 죽는 거 빼고 다 들어줄게♡: Just say it. Anything short of dying ♡
strings.그러면 '결속의 보석'이란 걸 좀 구해다 주시겠어요?: Could you find a Gem of Unity for me?
strings.결속의 보석? 그게 뭐죠?: A Gem of Unity? What's that?
A rare item that's been found around Eastland since long ago.
It's used to reinforce places made of magic. That's how it got its name.
Thanks to Shynic, we have none left. Sigh...
strings.결속의 보석 말고 내 방식대로 도우면 안 될까?: Could I help in my own way instead of finding a gem?
strings.그게… 다프네 때문에 제가 직접 결속의 보석을 이용해 결계를 다시 펼쳐야: Well... Because of Daphne, I need to rebuild the barrier myself using a Gem of Unity. I don't think another method will work...
All I need is the gem.
The magical beasts hide them well. Give them a scolding, and they'll hand one over.
strings.같이 가야지. 혼자 가면 재미없거든. 안 가?: You're coming with me. Going alone is boring. Aren't you coming?
strings.후우, 어쩔 수 없군요. 오랜만에 이스트랜드에 온 김에 샤이닉 님과 다녀: Whew. No choice, then. Since I'm back in Eastland after so long, I'll go with Shynic.
You came to rest and don't even get to. What a shame...
I only meant to ask Shynic...
It's fine. I'll come back quickly and rest then.
strings.사납고 못생겼지만, 귀여운 마수들이 가득 있는 목장이야. 너도 좋아할 만: A ranch full of fierce, ugly, but cute magical beasts. You'll like it.
strings.정말 재미있어♡ 잠자코 가기다?: It's really fun ♡ Just come along, okay?
strings.프레이오스에서 그런 일이 일어나고 있었구나. 게다가 그걸 네가 다 해결했: So that's what was happening in Freios. And you resolved all of it. Impressive.
Not at all. All I did was...
I know. All for our novice goddess and everyone else. Hehe.
strings.(샤이닉 님이 예전과는 조금 달라진 것 같네.): (Shynic seems a little different from before.)
strings.그런 의미로 귀찮은 일 좀 하는 거야, 알았지?: So think of this as doing another little chore for them, okay?
All right. By the way, that outfit... I don't think I've seen it before.
Only noticed now? Isn't it pretty? I commissioned it from Crisien.
strings.(샤이닉이 두 팔을 벌리고 %s 앞에서 새 옷을 보라는 듯 이리저리 움직: (Shynic spreads her arms and moves about in front of %s to show off her new outfit.)
strings.너무 예뻐요. 예전 옷과 비슷한 느낌이면서 더 가벼워 보이네요. 왠지 교: It's lovely. It has a similar feel to your old one, but looks lighter. Almost like a school uniform.
Really? I never went to school, so maybe I wanted to try the feeling.
strings.옷 만드는 김에 메디아도 이 스타일로 옷을 만들어 주려고 했는데, 정색해: I wanted to have one made in this style for Medea, too, but she looked so stern I was hurt.
Her face froze like she'd never speak to me again.
Medea is tall, so airy outfits do suit her better.
strings.어쨌든 이런 귀여운 스타일은 나밖에 어울리지 않는다는 대답을 들었으니까,: Anyway, she said only I could pull off something this cute, so it's fine ♡
I'm glad. Oh, that at your waist...
strings.너도 알고 있는 내 친구 물건이야. 계속 기억하고 싶어서 이렇게 달아 두: It belonged to a friend you know, too. I want to keep remembering them, so I'll wear it here. Pretty, isn't it?
strings.마음속에만 담아 둘까 했는데, 그건 싫더라고. 이왕이면 늘 함께 있는 게: I thought about keeping them only in my heart, but I didn't like that. Better to always be together.
strings.고마워, %s. 내 맘 알지? 모르면 죽일지도 몰라♡: Thank you, %s. You know how I feel, right? If not, I might kill you ♡
strings.당연히 알죠. 어, 저기 뭔가 이상한데요?: Of course I do. Oh, something looks strange over there.
Looks strange to you too, right? The ranch starts there.
To think there's a place in Avalon where flowers and trees grow so thickly...
strings.마수가 가득한 내 '카멜롯 목장'에 온 걸 환영해♡: Welcome to my Camelot Ranch, full of magical beasts ♡
strings.잠깐만요. '내' 카멜롯 목장이요? 샤이닉 님의 목장?: Wait. Your Camelot Ranch? You own it?
Didn't I tell you? I'm the ranch owner.
strings.샤이닉 님이 귀여운 걸 좋아하는 건 알고 있지만, 마수들의 목장을 맡고: I knew you liked cute things, but I didn't know you ran a ranch for magical beasts.
strings.오염된 아발론의 일부인데도, 이곳에서는 오염되지 않은 깨끗한 풀과 나무가: Even though it's part of polluted Avalon, clean, untainted grass and trees grow well here.
strings.다른 곳에서 옮겨 심은 풀과 나무들은 다 죽었는데, 이 목장 근처에서 옮: Plants transplanted from elsewhere all died, but ones moved from near this ranch survived.
strings.마수들이랑 관련이 있는 것 같은데, 아직 잘 모르겠어. 그래서 좀 더 연: I think it has something to do with the magical beasts, but I'm not sure yet. I'll study it some more. I have plenty of time.
strings.마수들이 말을 잘 들을 것 같지는 않은데, 괜찮아요?: They don't look like they'd be obedient. Is that all right?
strings.후후, 괜찮아. 녀석들이 재미있게 해 준 만큼 나도 재미있게 해 주고 있: Hehe, it's fine. I give them as much fun as they give me ♡
strings.오늘도 내가 왔다고 하면 반란을 일으킬 거야. 저번이 아마 145번째였던: When they hear I'm here today, they'll rebel. Last time was the 145th, I think...
strings.후후, 오늘 146회도 재미있을 거야. 같이 혼내 주러 가자♡: Hehe. Number 146 should be fun, too. Let's go teach them a lesson together ♡
strings.그건 그렇고 샤이닉 님, 결속의 보석을 금방 찾을 수 있을까요?: Shynic, do you think we'll find a Gem of Unity quickly?
strings.데이모스 교단의 광신도들이 마수를 데려와 키운 이유는 공격 용도로 쓰려는: The Deimos zealots brought magical beasts here to raise as weapons, but also to search for things like that.
strings.48회, 91회, 138회째 반란에서 나름 괜찮은 것들을 발견했거든. 결: I found some useful items during the 48th, 91st, and 138th rebellions. Not Gems of Bonds, but things useful for rebuilding Tartaros.
That doesn't sound like very good odds...
strings.후후, 걱정하지 마. 이번엔 확실해. 얼마 전에 대장이 소중하게 숨겨 놓: Hehe, don't worry. This time it's certain. I recently saw their leader hiding one away carefully.
strings.내가 다음에 가져가려고 내버려둔 거야. 가서 가져오자. 재미있을 거야♡: I left it to collect next time. Let's go get it. It'll be fun ♡
I'm sure it'll be fun for you...
strings.후후. 서두르자. 마수들이 일으키는 146회 반란을 아주 재미있게 진압하: Hehe. Hurry. Let's have a wonderful time putting down the magical beasts' 146th rebellion ♡
strings.(샤이닉을 따라 목장 입구로 보이는 길로 들어서자, 잠시 머물렀던 아발론: (Following Shynic through what appears to be the ranch entrance, I find a landscape unlike the Avalon I briefly visited.)
strings.여기가 아발론과 이어진 땅이라니… 신기하네요. 일반적으로 사람들이 알고: To think this land connects to Avalon... Amazing. It looks like the peaceful ranch people usually imagine.
strings.오염되지 않은 초록빛 수풀, 아름답게 자라는 꽃과 나무, 그리고 그 위를: Untainted green grass, beautiful flowers and trees, and rolling around on them... animals?
strings.저기 누워있는 마수는 '카멜롯'이야. 신기하게 생겼지?: That one lying over there is a Camelot. Strange-looking, isn't it?
strings.고양이 표정의 검은 뭔가가 카피바라 가죽을 뒤집어쓰고 있어. 처음엔 뭐: Some black thing with a cat's expression wearing a capybara skin. I thought it was grotesque at first, but it grew on me.
strings.광신도들이 어떻게 마계에서 데려왔는지는 모르겠지만, 사람들을 공격하거나: I don't know how the zealots brought them from the Demon Realm, but they probably meant to use them to attack people or defend Avalon.
strings.여기 생활이 마계보다 편한지 먹고 자고 뒹굴기만 해서 광신도들이 거의 포: Life here must be easier than in the Demon Realm. They only eat, sleep, and roll around, so the zealots seem to have given up.
You know magical beasts' nature. Absolute loyalty to the strong.
strings.우두머리가 있어. 그 녀석이 여기 있는 마수들을 선동해서 계속 반란을 일: They have a leader. It keeps stirring the others into rebellion. Hehe.
You have to admire its persistence.
...There's something else besides Camelots over there.
strings.저쪽에 있는 귀여운 마수는 '수리카타'야. \n사막에 사는 미어캣이라는:
Those cute magical beasts are Suricatas.
They resemble desert animals called meerkats. The zealots brought them from the Demon Realm, too.
Quite a feat, bringing them here.
strings.뭐, 방법이야 많으니까. 얘네들도 카멜롯과 노는 것 외에는 아무 데도 관: Well, there are plenty of ways. They had no interest in anything but playing with the Camelots.
strings.그런데 내가 카멜롯들을 혼내 주고 다니는 걸 보더니 갑자기 갑옷을 챙겨: But when they saw me scolding the Camelots, they suddenly put on armor, took up weapons, and attacked.
strings.그래서 내가 많이 놀아 주니까 얌전해졌어♡: So I played with them a lot, and they settled down ♡
strings.저기 날아다니는 건요? 프리링?: What about those flying ones? Prirings?
strings.저건 잡초링. 원래 근처에 살던 프리링인데, 카멜롯과 수리카타가 남긴 음: Those are Weedlings. They were ordinary Prirings living nearby, but eating leftovers from the Camelots and Suricatas turned them into living herbs. They became magical beasts.
strings.저 잡초링 머리에 있는 잎 보이지? 저걸 먹으면 마력이나 저주가 증폭되거: See the leaves on their heads? Eating them can amplify magic or curses, grant immunity to certain conditions, and help with skin regeneration, synthesis, and healing.
If you're not making medicine, wash them well and eat them with meat. Delicious.
I already called in that meat-loving man and finished testing.
strings.이 앞에 있는 애들은 얌전해. 내가 하도 혼내 주니까 이젠 내 말을 잘: The ones near the entrance are tame. I've scolded them so much that they listen now.
Which means the ones over there...
strings.지금 보니까 146번째 반란을 일으키려고 준비하는가 보네. 우리가 여기: Looks like they're preparing their 146th rebellion. The moment we cross this line, they'll swarm us.
strings.먼저 대장 카멜롯을 찾아서 쓰러뜨리고 결속의 보석을 빼앗는 사람이 이기는: Whoever finds and defeats the Captain Camelot and takes the Gem of Unity first wins. The loser dies ♡
strings.가 버리셨네. 후우, 이대로 죽을 순 없지…. 어서 대장 카멜롯을 찾으러: She's gone. Whew. I can't die like this... Better find the Captain Camelot.
strings.(모험가가 달려드는 마수들을 한참 동안 쓰러뜨린 후 주위를 둘러본다.): (After fighting off charging magical beasts for some time, the adventurer looks around.)
strings.하아, 마수가 이렇게나 많다니. 대체 몇 마리나 있는 거야…. 갈 수 있: Whew. So many magical beasts. How many are there...? I think I've searched everywhere, but no sign of the Captain Camelot.
strings.(모험가의 시선이 커다란 동물이 앉았던 것처럼 보이는 낡고 해진 작은 침: (The adventurer's gaze rests on a worn little bed that looks as though a large animal sat on it.)
strings.사이즈를 보니까 작은 카멜롯이 쓰는 건 아닌 것 같고, 대장 카멜롯 물건: Judging by the size, it's not for a little Camelot. Does it belong to the captain?
strings.(바로 그때, 모험가의 뒤로 커다란 그림자가 드리운다.): (Just then, an enormous shadow falls behind the adventurer.)
strings.(모험가가 서둘러 뒤로 물러나려 하지만, 커다란 그림자의 손에 붙잡혀 거: (The adventurer tries to retreat, but a huge hand catches them and lifts them upside down.)
strings.(커다란 카피바라 주둥이 안에 고양이 표정이 있는 기괴한 검은 마수와 모: (The adventurer meets the eyes of a bizarre black magical beast with a catlike expression inside an enormous capybara muzzle.)
strings.이, 이거 놓지 못해? 무, 무슨 힘이 이렇게 세?: L-let go! Why are you so strong?
strings.(모험가가 발버둥 쳐도 대장 카멜롯은 아랑곳하지 않고 그대로 흔든다. 그: (The Captain Camelot ignores the adventurer's struggles and shakes them. It pokes them with its other hand, then opens its mouth.)
strings.설마 먹으려고?: Are you going to eat me?
strings.(모험가의 말에 무슨 생각을 하는지 알 수 없던 표정이 환한 미소로 변한: (At those words, its unreadable expression turns into a bright smile.)
strings.이대로 먹히긴 싫다고!!: I'm not getting eaten like this!
strings.(그 말과 함께 대장 카멜롯의 손에 붙잡힌 모험가가 힘차게 반동을 일으켜: (Still in the captain's grip, the adventurer swings with all their strength and drives both feet into its eyes.)
strings.(대장 카멜롯이 모험가를 떨어뜨리고 두 손으로 두 눈을 감싸며 고통스러워: (The Captain Camelot drops the adventurer and covers both eyes in pain.)
So the thing inside its mouth was its true body...
strings.(대장 카멜롯이 눈을 비비다가 모험가를 바라보고는 쇳소리가 섞인 포효를: (The captain rubs its eyes, looks at the adventurer, and unleashes a metallic roar.)
Ugh, what power. Its roar alone keeps pushing me back...
strings.틈을 봐서 보석을 들고 나가야겠어. 어?: I'll need an opening to grab the jewel and leave. Huh?
strings.(대장 카멜롯이 두 손으로 X자를 그리며 고개를 좌우로 흔든다.): (The Captain Camelot crosses its arms into an X and shakes its head.)
strings.(대장 카멜롯이 두 손으로 O자를 그리며 고개를 끄덕인다. 그리고는 손에: (It forms a circle with both hands and nods. Then it clenches its fists and raises them toward the adventurer.)
strings.(모험가가 무기를 들자, 마치 기다리고 있던 것처럼 목장의 마수들이 달려: (As the adventurer raises their weapon, the ranch's magical beasts rush in as though waiting for this moment.)
strings.(대장 카멜롯이 %s에게 공격받은 충격으로 균형을 잃고 뒤로 넘어진다.): (%s's attack knocks the Captain Camelot off balance, and it falls backward.)
strings.(다시 일어나 달려들려 하지만 %s의 손짓에 놀라 주춤거린다. 그러고는: (It gets up to charge again, but flinches at %s's gesture. Then it sits down and flops onto its back.)
strings.(모험가의 말에 대장 카멜롯이 품 안에서 작은 백기를 꺼내 흔든다.): (In answer, the captain takes out a little white flag and waves it.)
strings.(대장 카멜롯이 두 손을 모아 빌면서 우는 시늉을 한다.): (The captain clasps its hands and pretends to cry while begging.)
strings.(이러고 뒤에서 덤비지는 않으려나 몰라….): (I hope it won't attack me from behind...)
strings.이제 보석 가져가도 돼?: Can I take the jewel now?
strings.(대장 카멜롯이 대답 대신 낡은 침대를 들고 탈탈 털자, 그 안에서 반짝: (Instead of answering, the captain picks up the old bed and shakes it. Several glittering jewels fall out.)
strings.(대장 카멜롯이 보석을 주워 %s에게 내민다.): (The captain picks up the jewels and offers them to %s.)
strings.(모험가가 주머니에서 루맨산 육포를 꺼내 대장 카멜롯의 입에 물리고는 배: (The adventurer takes Lumen jerky from their pocket, puts it in the captain's mouth, and scratches its belly.)
strings.이 파란색 보석은 아닌 것 같고, 이 토끼 모양의 보라색 보석…. 설마…: Probably not this blue jewel. This purple, rabbit-shaped one... Could it be...?
strings.(갑작스러운 샤이닉의 등장에 대장 카멜롯이 놀라 물고 있던 육포를 떨어뜨: (Shynic's sudden appearance startles the captain. It drops its jerky and slowly backs away.)
strings.대장 카멜롯, 147번째 반란도 기대할게♡: Captain Camelot, I'm looking forward to rebellion number 147 ♡
strings.(대장 카멜롯이 온몸을 부르르 떨더니 육포를 챙겨 어딘가로 서둘러 도망간: (The captain trembles, grabs its jerky, and hastily flees.)
strings.네가 얼마나 잘하나 보려고 입구에서 다른 마수에게 이번에는 내 부하가 갈: I wanted to see how you'd do, so I told another beast at the entrance that my subordinate was coming this time. They excitedly prepared rebellion number 146.
strings.카멜롯은 길들이기 어려운 마수라, 누군가에게 길드는 걸 자존심 상해하더라: Camelots are hard to tame. Being tamed wounds their pride. Beasts like that sometimes become so angry they kill themselves...
strings.적당히 기를 꺾었다가 다시 살려 주고, 그래야 해. 일단은 아발론에 여기: So you have to break their spirits a little, then let them recover. At least until I've properly transplanted all these flowers and trees throughout Avalon.
...Your intentions are good, but it feels strange.
strings.마수와 짜고 치는 건 아니니까 괜찮잖아♡: I'm not conspiring with them, so it's fine ♡
But you said my guess about this jewel was right.
Yes. The rabbit witch made it.
strings.놀라지 말고 일단 밖으로 나가자. 마수들을 또 상대하기는 귀찮지?: Don't look so surprised. Let's get outside first. You don't want to fight more beasts, do you?
I don't think this is the place.
strings.아무래도 토끼 마녀와 관련된 이야기니까 메디아에게 듣는 편이 낫겠지?: Since it concerns the rabbit witch, better to hear it from Medea, right?
strings.그건 그렇고 목장을 이대로 두고 가도 괜찮아요? 와서 한 일이라고는 마수: Can we just leave the ranch like this, though? All we've done is scold the magical beasts...
strings.괜찮아, 괜찮아. 걱정하지 마♡: It's fine, it's fine. Don't worry ♡
strings.대장 카멜롯은 반란이 실패한 게 분해서 또 마수들을 모아서 147번째 반: The Captain Camelot will be so frustrated at failing that it'll gather the beasts and plot rebellion number 147.
strings.마수들은 생각보다 단순해서 이게 내 의도라는 걸 몰라. 어쨌든 아발론 정: They're simpler than you'd think. They don't realize this is what I want. It'll stay like this until Avalon is purified ♡
I told the meat fool to come blow off steam sometimes, too. It'll be fine.
strings.(이쯤 되면 마수들이 불쌍해지네….): (I'm starting to feel sorry for the magical beasts...)
Let's go to Kali. Medea will be waiting.
strings.나도 가서 확인해 보고 싶은데…. 역시 안 되겠지?: I'd like to go check, too... But I can't, can I?
strings.힐다는 여기서 기다려 주세요. 밖은 여전히 위험해요. 그곳은 제가 잘 아: Hilda, please wait here. It's still dangerous outside. I know the place well. I'll go and bring it back.
strings.이 대륙에 드리웠던 고통이 영원히 끝나지 않을 것이라고 생각한 시간이 있: There was a time when I thought the suffering hanging over this continent would never end.
strings.하지만 모두를 만나고 밖으로 나가는 순간 믿게 됐고, 모든 게 끝나기를: But when I met everyone and went outside, I began to believe. To hope that everything could end...
This time, too, I believe... and hope everyone's suffering will end.
strings.(샤이닉이 메디아를 향해 작은 팔을 뻗어 힘껏 흔들고는 빠른 속도로 달려: (Shynic stretches out her little arms and waves vigorously at Medea, then runs into her embrace.)
strings.목장의 마수들이 무서워 봐야 거기서 거기지. 아, 전에 봤던 건 조금 달: The ranch's beasts can only be so scary. Though the one I saw long ago was different... It really came as though it would swallow everything...
strings.옛날이야기는 그만할게. 여기 결속의 보석이야. 받아. 이거면 되지, 메디: Enough old stories. Here's the Gem of Unity. This will do, right, Medea?
strings.네, 이거면 돼요. 고맙습니다, 샤이닉. 이 보석을 정말 오랜만에 보는군: Yes. Thank you, Shynic. It's been so long since I saw this gem... Sigh. A rabbit, of all shapes...
Hilda, hate Daphne if you want, but don't hate rabbits.
Medea, explain to %s why this gem is shaped like a rabbit. They're curious.
strings.그러시군요. 그럼 이 보석에 대해서 말씀드리죠. 거창한 이야기는 아니지만: I see. Then I'll tell you about it. It's not a grand story...
strings.오래전 칼리족은 지금 이곳과 마찬가지로 바깥에 노출되지 않도록 결계를 여: Long ago, just as we do now, the Kali people layered barriers around the village to conceal it and keep outsiders out.
strings.마력이 깃든 이 보라색 보석은 결계를 강화하는 역할을 하지만, 칼리족의: These purple gems reinforce barriers, but they always broke, unable to harmonize with the Kali barrier.
strings.보석의 힘만으로는 부족했는지 다프네는 제 마력을 추출해 결속의 보석을 강: Perhaps their power was insufficient. Daphne extracted my magic to strengthen a Gem of Unity. For some reason, she carved it into a rabbit. Sigh...
strings.덕분에 과거 칼리 마을은 잠시나마 안전했지만, 그 평온은 오래가지 못했어: It kept the old Kali village safe for a while, but that peace did not last...
strings.토끼 모양으로 된 결속의 보석은 단 하나뿐일 텐데…. 이게 이렇게 제 손: There should be only one rabbit-shaped Gem of Unity... And now it has returned to my hands.
I want to believe her concern for our people is real.
strings.보석은 결계를 세우기 위한 수단, 그 이상도 그 이하도 아니기에 신경 쓰: The gem is simply a means of building the barrier. I will try not to dwell on anything beyond that.
strings.어쨌든 다시 결계를 세울게요. 이거면 전보다 단단해질 거예요. 샤이닉이: In any case, I'll rebuild it. This will make it stronger than before. Even Shynic rushing in won't break it.
But please walk in normally next time.
strings.메디아 님, 이 보석으로 어떻게 결계를 만드시나요?: Medea, how do you make a barrier with this gem?
strings.두 분이 목장에 다녀오시는 동안 결계의 술식을 재구성해 마을 전체에 이미: While you were at the ranch, I reworked the spell and spread it throughout the village.
(Medea drops the Gem of Unity into a prepared hole, covers it with soil, then taps the spot with her staff.)
strings.(그러자 보랏빛 마력이 솟아올라 칼리 마을 전체를 감싼다.): (Violet magic rises and envelops all of Kali.)
I can feel the resolve to protect the village...
Wow, wonderful. I'm glad we went.
There's something I'd like you to help Medea with.
strings.당연히 도울 일이 있으면 도와야지. 그런데 무슨 일?: Of course I'll help. What is it?
strings.린도스 성지에서 뒤틀린 자 드미트리에게서 떨어져 나온 것, 기억하고 계시: You remember what fell from the Twisted One Dmitri in Lindos Holy Land?
You said you were making some kind of orb.
We made this black orb, but it needs to be more complete.
strings.그런 상황을 만들면 안 되겠지만, 다프네가 이리스 님을 해치려 하는 순간: We must prevent it from happening, but if Daphne tries to harm Iris, we will need it.
strings.완벽하게 하려면 뭐가 필요한가요?: What do we need to complete it?
strings.저도 가 봐야 알 것 같습니다. 다시는 가고 싶지 않았던 곳이지만… 내일: I'll have to go there to know. It's somewhere I never wanted to return to... But I intend to go tomorrow.
strings.예전 칼리 마을이 있던 곳?: Where the old Kali village stood?
No... I no longer have those memories...
strings.힐다는 밖으로 나가면 안 되는 상황이고, %s도 가는 길을 잘 모를 것: Hilda can't go outside, and %s probably doesn't know the way, either.
strings.날 데려가. 내가 길을 알거든. 그러면 나 타르타로스로 가서 준비해야겠다: Take me. I know the way. I'll go to Tartaros and get ready.
strings.%s, 내일 아침에 메디아하고 타르타로스로 와. 기다리고 있을게♡ 메디아: %s, come to Tartaros with Medea tomorrow morning. I'll be waiting ♡ Medea, make sure you wear that outfit. Okay?
strings.샤이닉이 길을 알고 있을 거라고 생각하긴 했지만, 이런 식으로 같이 가게: I thought she might know the way, but I didn't expect us to go together like this... No helping it.
strings.%s, 그럼 내일 잘 부탁드리겠습니다. 오늘은 마을에서 편히 쉬시고 내일: %s, I'll be counting on you tomorrow. Rest comfortably in the village today, and we'll go together.
Of course, Medea. I'm glad I can help.
strings.(예전 칼리 마을이 있던 미스트우드…. 어떤 곳인지 궁금하네. 어차피 갈: (Mistwood, where the old Kali village stood... I wonder what it's like. I'll find out when we get there...)
Let's finish everything and go back... To where I belong...
Melvic, I'll be back soon. Medea will arrive shortly.
strings.샤이닉 님, 어디 가시게요? 그리고 메디아 님이 오신다고요?: Shynic, where are you going? And Medea is coming?
We're going to where the Kali people's old village was.
strings.칼리족이 아드리카에 오기 전 마을이겠군요. 언젠가 노엘 씨에게 들은 적이: Before they came to Adrika, then. Noel told me about it once.
strings.메디아에게 숙제가 좀 남아서 내가 도와주려고. 재미있겠지?♡: Medea has a little unfinished business, so I'm helping. Sounds fun, right? ♡
strings.재미는 모르겠지만, 샤이닉 님이 부디 메디아 님께도 많은 도움이 됐으면: I don't know about fun, but I hope you can be of great help to her.
Medea is my benefactor, just as you are.
Hehe. You've grown, Melvic. Saying things like that.
You seem to forget sometimes, Shynic, but I'm already an adult.
I know. Then be as adult as you like.
strings.역시 샤이닉 님, 감사합니다. 저기 메디아 님이 오시네요. 노엘이 타르타: Just like you, Shynic. Thank you. Oh, Medea is coming. Noel seems to have escorted her from the entrance to Tartaros.
Medea, I'm so glad you've come to Tartaros.
strings.노엘, 미안해요. 오늘은 일이 있어서 노엘을 오래 못 보고 갈 것 같네요: I'm sorry, Noel. I have business today, so I can't stay with you long.
strings.괜찮아요. 그런데 메디아 님께 이런 옷이 있었나요? 뭔가 조금 아쉬운 느: It's all right. But did you have an outfit like this? Somehow, it seems a little lacking...
strings.역시 샤이닉 님! 옷 볼 줄 아신다니까요. 메디아 님 스타일이 좋아서 이: Of course! You have such an eye for clothes, Shynic. Medea's figure makes even this look good. Wow, beautiful!
strings.그렇지? 예쁘지? 여기서 잠깐 기다려. 옷 갈아입고 나올게♡: Right? Pretty, isn't it? Wait here a moment. I'll go change ♡
It's been a while, Noel. You've become quite smooth.
strings.먹고살려면 어쩔 수 없죠, 후후. 그동안 잘 지내셨나요, %s 님?: You do what you must to make a living. Hehe. Have you been well, %s?
strings.요즘 이스트랜드를 돌아다니기가 편해진 데다 장사가 잘돼서 좋아요. 엘리도: It's easier to travel around Eastland now, and business is good. I've saved some Ely, too. Still a long way from opening a shop, though.
strings.메디아 님과 샤이닉님, %s 님 덕분이에요. 후후. 그럼 좋은 시간 보내: It's thanks to you, Shynic, and %s. Hehe. Have a wonderful time. I'd better go.
strings.저도 물러나겠습니다. 노엘 씨, 잠깐 저 좀 봐요. 노엘 씨를 통해서 구: I'll take my leave, too. Noel, a moment. There's something I'd like to obtain through you...
Really, Melvic? I'm delighted. This way, then. Come on, come on.
strings.노엘도 많이 성장헸군요. 마을 밖으로 나갈 때 걱정을 많이 했는데, 이젠: Noel has grown so much. I worried when Noel left the village, but I think everything will be fine now.
strings.자, 기다렸지?: All right, did I keep you waiting?
No, no. I'm doing it because I want to. I simply want to help.
strings.여기서 거기로 가는 제일 가까운 길이 지스크 영지에 있어. 호숫가 근처일: The shortest route from here goes through Zisk Plains. Near the lake, I think. Let's go.
strings.호숫가요? 그 근처면 누굴 좀 만나고 가도 될까요?: The lake? If we're nearby, could we stop to see someone?
Are these the right lyrics? Hmm. Ah, ah...
strings.호수에 빠진 기억이 영원히 남지는 않아요♬: Memories fallen into the lake do not stay forever ♬
strings.손을 뻗어 담고 싶지만, 흘러가 버려 다시는 돌아오지 않아요♩: I reach to hold them, but they flow away and never return ♩
strings.돌아가고 싶다면 그때를 떠올리는 것뿐♪: If you wish to go back, all you can do is remember ♪
strings.(어디선가 들려오는 박수 소리에 제나가 놀라 뒤로 물러난다.): (Jenna startles at applause from somewhere and steps back.)
You startled me. I thought a ghost had appeared... Oh, I'm the ghost.
strings.모험가님도 메디아 님도 오랜만이에요. 저는 항상 잘 있어요. 그런데 저분: Adventurer, Medea, it's been so long. I'm always well. And is that Shynic?
That's right. That man's little sister.
strings.그런데 어떻게 세 분이 여기까지 오신 거예요? 보통 일이 아닌 것 같네요: What brings all three of you here? It doesn't seem ordinary...
strings.오래전에 칼리족의 마을이 있던 곳에 가 보려고 왔어. 이 앞에 올라가는: We're going to where the Kali people's village stood long ago. There should be a path up ahead.
Have you visited the territory before? Yes, that's the road to Mistwood.
strings.익시온이 날 병기로 다루던 시절에 데이모스 교단의 광신도들을 처단한다면서: When Ixion treated me as a weapon, I think we passed through Zisk Plains and came nearby, supposedly to wipe out the Deimos zealots.
It's ancient history. I'm fine. That villain is gone.
strings.저, 실례가 안 된다면 하나만 여쭤보고 싶은데…. 혹시 여러분이 거기로: If you don't mind, may I ask something...? Is your visit connected to that person?
strings.그 토끼 마녀를 말씀하시는 거라면 아니에요. 가이아 님을 닮은 분이셨어요: If you mean the rabbit witch, no. Someone who looked like Gaia.
strings.미뉴에트를 보셨군요. 전에는 가이아 님의 현신이었지만, 지금은 축복받아: You saw Minuet. She used to be Gaia's incarnation, but now she's been blessed and travels the continent of her own free will...
She looked dazed, as though something had enchanted her. I'm a little worried.
You wouldn't know, Jenna, but Minuet always looks dazed.
strings.그냥 영지를 건너 그쪽으로 간 것 같기는 해요. 미뉴에트에게는 별일 없을: She probably just crossed the territory and went that way. Minuet will be fine. Don't worry too much.
strings.제나, 우리는 미뉴에트와 상관없이 볼일이 있어서 가는 거예요. 그러니까: Jenna, we're going there on separate business. Nothing to do with Minuet. Please don't worry.
strings.네, 알겠어요…. 그럼 곧바로 떠나시나요?: All right... Are you leaving right away?
I'm sorry we have to leave so soon after meeting again.
strings.괜찮아요. 이렇게라도 봐서 다행이에요. 대신 제가 미스트우드 앞까지만 배: It's fine. I'm glad I saw you at all. May I at least see you to Mistwood's entrance?
I can't go far, but I can reach there.
This is the boundary between the territory and Mistwood.
Straight ahead to Mistwood... Yes, I remember.
I'll head back, then. Please take care.
strings.(제나가 손을 흔들어 인사하자마자 그 자리에서 증발하듯 모습을 감춘다.): (Jenna waves goodbye, then vanishes on the spot as though evaporating.)
An old memory came to mind...
Long ago, a beautifully shining forest stood here...
strings.그때 익시온이 '칼리'라는 신비한 일족이 사는 마을이 여기 어딘가에 있다: Ixion said there was a village somewhere here where a mysterious people called the Kali lived.
strings.그 영감도 칼리의 힘을 원했지만 찾지 못했어. 마력이 점점 고갈되고 있었: The old man wanted the Kali's power, too, but couldn't find them. His magic was running out.
strings.…내가 그 인간의 병기로 강해지면서 계속 그 인간 마력을 갉아먹고 있었지: ...As I grew stronger as his weapon, I kept eating away at his magic...
I sensed magic somewhere in Mistwood, but kept my mouth shut.
strings.그때 그 영감이 칼리족을 찾아냈다면 나도 죽었을 거야. 더는 필요가 없었: If he'd found the Kali then, I would have died, too. He wouldn't have needed me anymore.
And we would never have met.
Whew. Enough old stories. Shall we go? A little farther...
That's where Kali village stood... There seems to be something there.
...Yes... I can feel something like the old village, but something is unfamiliar...
strings.저기 보이세요? 카멜롯 목장의 마수들이 여기 있는데, 뭐지?: Do you see that? The magical beasts from Camelot Ranch are here. Why?
strings.목장 마수들 때문은 아닌 것 같고…, 우리를 기다리고 있는 뭔가가 있다는: I don't think it's the ranch's beasts... It feels as though something is waiting for us.
All the escaped ones are here. That settles it...
strings.(샤이닉이 어깨에 메고 있던 데스사이드를 두 손으로 들자, 메디아도 지팡: (Shynic takes the Death Scythe from her shoulder in both hands. Medea tightens her grip on her staff.)
strings.그러면 제대로 맞이할 수 있게 해 주자♡ 이왕이면 우리 목장 마수들도 혼: Then let's give it a proper greeting ♡ And scold our ranch's beasts while we're at it!
strings.(카멜롯 목장에서 탈출한 마수들을 어느 정도 쫓은 후에 도착한 장소, 메: (After driving away some escaped beasts, they reach their destination. Medea sees an enormous pillar of light and sinks to the ground.)
I could have come before. Why did I only come now...?
(Medea closes her eyes and quietly raises her staff, sensing the surging pillar of light.)
Shall we rest and talk before going in? Ask anything you'd like.
It's barren now, but long ago this was a forest always filled with mist.
strings.마치 숲이 안개에 삼켜진 듯한 신비한 분위기에 이끌려 외부 사람들이 들어: Outsiders were drawn by the mysterious sight of a forest seemingly swallowed by fog. Most became lost.
strings.같은 곳을 헤매다가 간신히 빠져나온 이들은 이곳을 신비한 숲, '미스트우: Those who wandered in circles and barely escaped called it the mysterious forest, Mistwood, and rarely approached again.
strings.네, 이 숲에 칼리 일족의 마을이 있었죠. 그때도 마을의 이름은 '칼리': Yes, the Kali village stood in this forest. Its name was Kali then, too...
A place our people loved and cherished...
strings.다시는 이곳에 올 일이 없을 줄 알았는데…. 역시 사람 일은 모르는군요…: I never thought I'd return... We truly cannot know what life holds...
Sigh. I suppose I can't help being shaken...
strings.많은 기억이 떠오르는군요. 그중 어느 것이 저만의 기억인지는 알 수 없지: Many memories. Though I cannot tell which are truly my own...
I think I was very happy until we left this place.
strings.어린 저는 친구들과 함께 숲길을 뛰어다녔고, 어른들은 그런 아이들이 길을: As a child, I ran along the forest paths with friends. The adults put signs everywhere to keep us from getting lost.
strings.저녁이 되면 아이들은 집으로 돌아갔고, 저 또한 다른 어른의 손에 이끌려: At dusk, the children went home. An adult would take my hand, lead me to a meal, and put me to bed.
strings.그러던 어느 날, 안개가 사라지고 어둠이 찾아왔죠…. 짐작하시겠지만 그: Then one day, the mist vanished and darkness came... As you can imagine, within it were the Deimos zealots and the one leading them.
strings.네. 그의 손짓에 사람들의 비명이 숲을 가득 채웠죠. 저는 혼란스러워 어: Yes. At his gesture, screams filled the forest. I was so confused I didn't know what to do...
strings.이런 이야기를 다 하게 되는군요. 제가 여러분을 많이 신뢰하고 있는가 보: To think I'm telling you all this. I must trust you a great deal.
strings.프레이오스에도 비슷한 표현이 있던 것 같군요. 마력의 소용돌이, 그런 것: I believe Freios has a similar term. Think of it as a vortex of magic...
strings.수많은 빛의 선들이 모여 만들어진 기둥…. 언제부턴가 그 선이 제게 보였: A pillar formed from countless lines of light... At some point, I began seeing those lines. No one besides Daphne and me could see them.
strings.저는 그에게 그것이 무엇이냐고 질문했지만, 그는 대수롭지 않게 넘겼습니다: I asked her what they were, but she brushed it off.
strings.저 역시 별일 아니라고 생각했지만, 어느 순간부터 그 선이 마을 사람들의: I thought it was nothing, too. But eventually, the villagers began to see them.
strings.그러던 어느 날, 그 선은 칼리 마을을 감싸고 있던 안개를 지워 버렸습니: Then one day, the lines erased the mist surrounding Kali. The Deimos zealots hunting our people invaded.
strings.고통스러운 비명이 숲을 가득 채우던 그날, 그 사람은 일족을 구한다며 어: That day, as agonized screams filled the forest, she made a choice to save our people...
strings.그는 빛의 선을 끌어당겨 갈기갈기 찢어 허공에 퍼뜨렸고, 마을은 저 선이: She pulled the lines of light apart and scattered them through the air. The village became enclosed in the space they formed.
strings.그 선에 닿은 광신도는 비명을 지르며 녹아 버렸지만, 그것만으로 끝나지: Zealots who touched the lines screamed and melted. But it didn't end there. The lines trapped part of the village, too.
strings.지금은 이 빛의 기둥이 우리에게만 보이지만, 이는 많은 빛의 선이 모여: Only we can see this pillar now, but it is made of many lines of light. There is a path between them.
A space filled only with silence within a twisted spiral... The Spiral of Silence...
strings.저희가 찾는 게 여기 있다는 거죠? 그렇다면 저 빛의 선 안으로 들어가야: What we're looking for is here, then? So we need to go inside those lines of light...
Those lines... A greater power than the Wheel is at work here.
strings.수레바퀴는 내가 실수로 위대한 벽을 뚫어 버리긴 했지만, 그래도 초인을: I accidentally pierced the great wall with the Wheel, but it's still only a place where Transcendents and others connected to gods can come and go.
strings.그런데 이건 위대한 벽 일부를 끌어와 만든 것 같아. 차원이 다른 수준이: But this seems to have been made by pulling in part of the great wall itself. It's on a completely different level...
strings.그건 몇백 년 전인데… 다프네는 신의 힘을 끌어와 사용한 거야?: That was centuries ago... Daphne drew on divine power even then?
strings.최근 힐다의 요청으로 뒤틀린 자에게서 나온 조각을 정화하면서 확신했습니다: I became certain while purifying the fragment from the Twisted One at Hilda's request.
That she is capable of wielding power like this...
And that something connected to gods must be somewhere in the old Kali village.
strings.그 물건이 왜 칼리에 있는 걸까요?: Why would such a thing be in Kali?
Perhaps she needed it to make me a perfect witch...
Sniff, sniff. I smell it. I definitely sense something. We'd better find it...
strings.어쨌든 빨리 찾아서 그 물건을 완성하죠. 이대로 저 안으로 들어가면 되나: Let's find it quickly and finish the item. Do we go straight inside?
There used to be no way in. But now there is.
The little girl has grown stronger than she was then.
strings.(메디아가 지팡이를 들자 '침묵의 나선'으로 보이는 빛의 기둥이 요동친다: (Medea raises her staff, and the pillar of light called the Spiral of Silence surges.)
Shynic, use your Death Scythe to cut through the tightly bound lines and make an opening.
(Shynic leaps up and swings her Death Scythe at the pillar. It parts slightly, revealing a gap.)
...It's closing again. One strike won't be enough.
strings.제가 할 일은 없나요?: Is there anything I can do?
strings.우리가 계속해서 이 빛의 기둥을 붙잡고 닫히지 않게 할게요. 누군가는 그: We'll keep holding the pillar open. Someone needs to search for the item. Please.
strings.메디아, 그토록 다시 오고 싶었던 고향이잖아. 같이 가서 그 물건을 찾아: Medea, this is the home you've wanted so badly to return to. Go together and find it.
strings.내가 어떻게든 할게. 걱정 말고 다녀와♡: I'll manage somehow. Don't worry. Go on ♡
Medea, let's trust Shynic and go.
Thank you, Shynic. We'll be quick.
strings.(두 사람이 샤이닉을 뒤로하고 갈라진 빛의 선 사이로 뛰어 들어간다.): (Leaving Shynic behind, the two leap between the parted lines of light.)
Perse, could you open the Netherworld's gate for a moment? I need a little power.
strings.(그 순간, 샤이닉의 머리 위로 어디선가 흘러나온 마력으로 가득 찬 검은: (A black sphere filled with magic from somewhere rises above Shynic's head.)
strings.그럼 어디 열심히 난도질해 볼까?♡: Now, shall I give it a good slashing? ♡
strings.(메디아가 지팡이를 들어 바닥을 내리치자 주위를 감싸고 있던 어둠이 물러: (Medea raises her staff and strikes the ground. The surrounding darkness retreats.)
strings.(모험가의 시선이 틈 안 세계의 모습을 담기 위해 분주하게 움직인다.): (The adventurer's eyes dart about, taking in the world within the gap.)
strings.마치 저주받은 것 같은, 아니, 저주받은 모습이군요…. 나선으로 맴도는: As though cursed... No, it is cursed. Trapped in a spiraling vortex of magic...
It's similar to the current village, yet so different...
Aside from the strange plants growing everywhere, yes...
strings.메디아 님, 누구 목소리인지 아세요?: Medea, do you recognize the voice?
strings.오래전 저와 함께 지냈던 마을 사람들입니다. 더는 이 세상에 없는 분들이: Villagers I lived with long ago. People no longer in this world...
strings.귀 기울이지 마세요…. 데이모스 교단의 광신도들과 함께 숲을 덮친 악마가: Don't listen. They're false voices made by the demons that attacked the forest with the Deimos zealots.
So clear, even after all this time.
Medea, why are you only here now? We've been waiting.
strings.다프네의 선택으로 칼리 마을 주민의 반은 살아남을 수 있었습니다. 나머지: Half the villagers survived thanks to Daphne's choice. The others could not be saved...
strings.살아남은 주민들은 침묵의 나선을 만들고 사라진 다프네를 원망하지 않았습니: The survivors didn't resent Daphne for making the Spiral of Silence and disappearing. Instead, they pitied me, left behind.
strings.그분들은 알고 계셨을 겁니다. 제가 다프네의 손에서 완벽한 마녀가 되기: They must have known. That I had remained unchanged for so long, so Daphne could make me a perfect witch.
strings.메디아, 같이 놀자. 다프네 님이 또 가뒀어?: Medea, come play. Did Daphne lock you up again?
Would you like some bread, Medea? You must have been hungry.
And that I was frightened in that situation...
The Kali people didn't hate me. They gave me strength...
They sacrificed themselves and asked me to save the young villagers...
strings.그분들의 힘을 받은 순간부터, 저는 이스트랜드에서 신의 힘을 일부 깨닫는: From the moment I received their power, I became a Transcendent in Eastland, understanding part of divine power. Some of the witch's power Daphne had planted within me awakened, too.
I used to hate what I was. But now I've accepted it all.
strings.살려 줘, 메디아. 우리 이대로 죽는 거야…?: Save us, Medea. Are we going to die like this...?
Medea, it's your fault. We're dying because of you.
The Kali were attacked because you were here...
If the false voices keep coming, demons must be trapped here, too.
strings.조심해야겠네요…. 메디아 님, 괜찮으세요?: We should be careful... Are you all right, Medea?
strings.예전이라면 무너졌겠지만 지금은 아닙니다. 후우, 일단 저길 보시겠어요?: Once, this would have broken me. But not now. Whew. Would you look over there?
The lines in the sky are moving...
I think something is happening somewhere over there.
Daphne abandoned us and ran away... I don't want to die...
strings.(메디아가 지팡이를 들어 하늘을 향해 뻗자, 뭔가에 가려져 보이지 않던: (Medea raises her staff toward the sky, revealing demons hidden behind something unseen.)
strings.끝까지 가는 동안, 이런 식으로 저와 주민들을 괴롭히던 악마들이 나타날: On our way to the end, we'll encounter demons that tormented the villagers and me like this...
That's reassuring. I'm counting on you.
False voices, then illusions... Demons still bring out the very worst...
strings.(메디아가 지팡이로 마지막으로 남은 악마의 머리를 내리친다. 그러자 흉측: (Medea strikes the last demon's head with her staff. It writhes, lets out a hideous sound, and evaporates.)
As always, fighting demons and magical beasts like these feels awful.
strings.그건 그렇고 옛 칼리 마을을 다 돌아다닌 것 같은데… 우리가 찾는 건 보: I think we've searched the whole old village... But there's no sign of what we need.
strings.(메디아의 시선이 머문 방향에서 누군가가 천천히 모습을 드러낸다.): (Someone slowly emerges in the direction Medea is watching.)
strings.(모험가가 다가가려고 하는 순간, 메디아가 손을 붙잡으며 말린다.): (As the adventurer starts forward, Medea catches their hand.)
strings.(가이아처럼 보인 인물이 다가오는 순간, 메디아가 놀라 뒤로 살짝 물러난: (As the figure resembling Gaia approaches, Medea startles and steps back.)
strings.(이름을 불린 존재가 두 사람을 바라보자 모두가 있던 공간이 흔들리기 시: (The being turns toward them at her name, and the entire space begins to shake.)
strings.(마치 가이아가 타락한 것 같은 느낌의 미뉴에트가 기도를 하다 손을 하늘: (Minuet, looking like a fallen Gaia, prays and raises her hands toward the sky. Enormous plant stalks burst forth and attack them.
strings.(메디아의 지팡이 끝에서 흘러나온 빛이 미뉴에트의 공격을 받아친다.): (Light flows from the tip of Medea's staff and counters Minuet's attack.)
strings.(그러나 미뉴에트는 멈출 생각이 없는 듯 계속해서 빛의 소용돌이를 만들어: (But Minuet shows no sign of stopping, continuing to create vortices of light.)
strings.메디아 님, 미뉴에트를 막을 방법이 없을까요?: Medea, is there a way to stop her?
strings.%s, 잘 들어요. 지금 미뉴에트를 원래대로 돌리기 위해서는 한 가지 방: %s, listen carefully. There's only one way to restore Minuet now. In this situation, it's our best option...
strings.우리의 힘으로 저 힘을 짓눌러야 해요. 그래야 미뉴에트도 구하고 그 물건: We must overpower that force with our own. Then we can save Minuet and find the item.
strings.(모험가가 아무런 감정도 느껴지지 않는 미뉴에트와 눈을 마주하고서 조용히: (The adventurer meets Minuet's emotionless gaze and quietly tightens their grip on their weapon.)
Minuet, I'm sorry. Hold on a little longer.
strings.(미뉴에트의 비명과 함께 마치 살아 있는 듯이 솟아오르던 주변의 가시덩굴: (At Minuet's scream, the thorny vines surging as though alive shatter like glass and fall to the ground.)
strings.(이어 미뉴에트를 감싸고 있던 검은 그림자가 흐릿해진다.): (The black shadow surrounding Minuet begins to fade.)
Now! Strike this light as hard as you did before.
strings.(%s의 무기가 메디아가 만든 투명한 빛을 가격하자 여러 개로 갈라져 괴: (%s's weapon strikes the transparent light Medea created. It splits into several streams and flows toward the suffering Minuet.)
strings.(빛은 그대로 미뉴에트의 머리까지 감싸며 어두웠던 그의 모습을 지워 간다: (The light envelops Minuet up to her head, erasing her darkened appearance.)
strings.(검은 그림자가 완전히 사라지고, 나쁜 기운이 모두 사라진 미뉴에트가 식: (The black shadow vanishes completely. Freed of the evil presence, Minuet sinks to the ground in a cold sweat.)
strings.두 분이 왜 여기에…? 저는 여기서 뭘 하고 있었던 걸까요?: Why are you two here...? What was I doing?
I came here while traveling, then seem to have lost consciousness...
strings.(미뉴에트가 품에서 무언가를 꺼내 메디아와 %s에게 보여 준다. 병 안에: (Minuet takes something from her clothes and shows Medea and %s. Bead-like objects in a bottle glow softly.)
To think this was what did that to Minuet... Sigh...
strings.메디아 님, 이 물건에 관해서 설명 좀 해 주세요. 우리가 찾는 그 물건: Medea, please explain. Is this what we're looking for?
It feels strangely nostalgic... This belongs to the ancient gods...
It's only natural that Minuet, Gaia's incarnation, would react to this.
strings.다프네는 이 물건으로 뭘 하려고 했죠?: What did Daphne intend to do with it?
She came with us. She's outside helping us stay inside.
I think she's drawing on the Netherworld's power...
This won't do. Let's get out quickly. I'll explain once we're outside.
strings.이쪽에 들어왔던 곳으로 가는 지름길이 있어요. 절 따라오세요!: There's a shortcut back to where we entered. Follow me!
strings.(메디아가 밖으로 제대로 나오지 못하는 미뉴에트를 잡아당긴다.): (Medea pulls Minuet, who is struggling to get out, through the opening.)
strings.이게 누구야? 미뉴에트, 안녕♡: Well, who is this? Hello, Minuet ♡
(Shynic wipes the sweat from her brow and catches the unsteady Minuet. Then she smiles brightly at the lines of light, closed once more.)
strings.응? 나 안 괜찮아야 하는 거야?: Hm? Am I supposed not to be?
strings.그건 아니고… 명계의 힘은 왜 쓰셨어요?: It's not that... Why did you use the Netherworld's power?
strings.어떻게 알았어? 몰래 쓰려고 했는데…. 어, 미뉴에트가 말했어?: How did you know? I meant to use it secretly... Oh, did Minuet tell you?
strings.가지고 있는 힘만으로는 여유가 없어서 말이지♡ 어쨌든 다들 무사히 나와서: My own power didn't leave much room to spare ♡ Anyway, I'm glad everyone got out safely.
strings.메디아, 나 괜찮아. 괜찮아. 어쩌다 한 번 쓰는 거라 괜찮다고. 예전처: Medea, I'm fine. Really. It's only once in a while. I won't go berserk like before.
strings.응, 조심할게. 맞다. 그 물건을 찾았으니까 나왔겠지?: Okay, I'll be careful. Right, you came out because you found the item?
strings.(메디아가 궁금해하는 샤이닉 앞에 찾은 물건을 들어 보인다.): (Medea holds up the item for the curious Shynic.)
So this is what Hilda was looking for. Strange-looking... Wait... This...
strings.이 물건은 다프네가 '공허의 결석'이라 불렀던 것…. 고대신의 유해에서: Daphne called this a Void Stone... Beads refined from some of the power extracted from an ancient god's remains...
strings.이걸 어디서 구했는지 알 수 없습니다만, 어디에 사용할지는 알고 있습니다: I don't know where she obtained it, but I know what she intended to use it for.
strings.아시다시피 저는 그의 손에 의해 완벽한 마녀가 될 예정이었습니다. 그러기: As you know, I was meant to become a perfect witch at her hands. That required great power.
In the worst case, I might have become an artificial god...
...That mad rabbit witch! She was going to use this on you...
Shynic, it didn't happen. Please calm down.
The Deimos zealots' attack disrupted Daphne's plans.
strings.어쨌든 다프네에게 지금도 공허의 결석이 필요한지 어떤지는 모르겠지만, 저: I don't know whether Daphne still needs the Void Stones. But for us, they've become ingredients for something we need in the coming battle.
strings.그 힘 때문에 미뉴에트가 영향을 받아 그런 모습이 된 것도 무리는 아니었: No wonder their power affected Minuet and changed her like that.
She went berserk in a form resembling a fallen Gaia.
I'm sorry... I didn't mean to...
strings.미뉴에트, 지금은 멀쩡한 상태야?: Minuet, are you back to normal now?
Now we just need to bring this carefully to Hilda...
strings.메디아, 이제 여기는 어떻게 할 거야? 빛의 선이 살짝 희미해졌어도 완벽: Medea, what will you do with this place? The lines of light have faded a little, but I doubt they'll disappear completely...
strings.여기는 제 과거이자 현재, 그리고 미래가 될 거예요. 저의 삶이 다하는: This place is my past, my present, and my future. For as long as I live, I'll keep searching for a way to save it...
strings.훌륭해, 메디아. 최근 들은 말 중에 최고로 좋아♡: Wonderful, Medea. That's my favorite thing I've heard lately ♡
strings.궁금한 게 있는데, 미뉴에트는 언제부터 아드리카를 벗어날 수 있게 됐죠?: I've been wondering, Minuet. When did you become able to leave Adrika?
strings.삶이란 걸 제대로 느끼고 싶다고 생각했을 때부터 아드리카를 떠날 수 있게: When I began wishing to truly experience life...
I think Gaia gave it to me as a gift...
strings.저는 여기서 헤어질게요…. 아직 가 보지 못한 곳이 많아서 다른 곳으로: I'll part with you here... There are still so many places I haven't seen. I'd like to travel elsewhere.
strings.흐음, 괜찮을까요?: Hmm. Will that be all right?
After this, I'm sure Minuet will be careful.
strings.안 괜찮으면 괜찮게 만들어야지. 미뉴에트, 사고 치면 내가 가이아 님께: If it's not all right, we'll make it all right. Minuet, cause trouble and I'll scold you so hard I'll have to ask Gaia's forgiveness ♡
I'll go now... See you later...
strings.(미뉴에트가 가볍게 손을 흔들어 인사한 후 어딘가를 향해 걸어간다.): (Minuet gives a small wave and walks away.)
Minuet really has changed... Just as we have...
Shall we return? Hilda will be waiting.
strings.(메디아가 기다리고 있던 힐다의 손에 빛나는 구슬이 담긴 병을 쥐여 준다: (Medea places the bottle of shining beads in Hilda's waiting hand.)
Merimel asked for instruction and caught her.
I don't know why, but Shynic seems kind to Kali women...
strings.이제 그걸 어떻게 사용하면 되는 거야?: How do we use it now?
strings.(힐다가 손 안에 있던 검은 구체를 구슬이 담긴 병에 넣고 밀봉한다.): (Hilda puts the black orb from her hand into the bottle of beads and seals it.)
The stones will soon dissolve and seep into the black orb. Here, take it.
You can't use it immediately, but when the time comes, it should help somehow.
I know you and Medea have lots of questions for me, %s, but you're holding back.
If you want my story, let's deal with the villains first.
Yes. Once it's over, everything will work out... For me, too...
Come to think of it, %s, you haven't had a proper rest since coming here. Get some rest. We don't know what might happen.
I'm sorry, %s. You came to Kali and spent all your time helping me...
strings.어, 마을 입구 쪽에 사람들이 몰려 있는 것 같은데…. 무슨 일이지? 시: Oh, people are gathering at the village entrance... What's happening? It's noisy. Has someone arrived?
Medea, sorry. I'll hide for a bit.
Sorry. Just for a moment. I'll stay in the village.
strings.뭐야, 그새 사라졌네. 어디 갔지?: She's already gone. Where did she go?
We'll hear Hilda's story later. Let's go see...
strings.메리멜, 조금 전까지 샤이닉 님과 같이 있지 않았어?: Merimel, weren't you with Shynic just now?
I said I needed something, and she ran to Tartaros to bring it.
strings.(베이넌이 메리멜 앞으로 나가 다가오는 자를 향해 활을 겨눈다.): (Beinan steps in front of Merimel and aims his bow at an approaching figure.)
I'm neither a strange person nor a dangerous elf. Please calm down.
...Everyone who says that is strange and dangerous.
strings.전혀 그렇지 않습니다. 제가 얼마나 멋진 엘프인데요. 귀엽고 상냥한 칼리: Not at all. I'm a wonderful elf. A cute, kind Kali girl like you simply must know that!
strings.일단 거기서 멈춰. 다가오지 마. 한 걸음이라도 발을 내디딘다면 이 화살: Stop there. Don't come closer. Take one more step, and this arrow goes through your heart.
Answer my questions. Where did you come...
strings.아, 설명을 해 드려야겠군요. 프레이오스 대륙에서는 다크엘프를 도크알프라: Oh, I should explain. In Freios, dark elves are also called Dokkalfr.
strings.하지만 악이 아닌 어둠을 따를 뿐, 나쁜 엘프는 아닙니다. 이스트랜드에서: But we follow darkness, not evil. We're not bad elves. I suppose in Eastland we're simply considered bad.
strings.모든 엘프를 대신해서 사죄드리죠. 아름다운 청년 엘프 사제가 사죄드리니: Allow me to apologize on behalf of all elves. Surely you must accept an apology from a handsome young elven priest.
How did you learn of Kali village? You're no ordinary person. Identify yourself...
Such a discerning eye. As you can see, I'm no ordinary person.
strings.프레이오스 대륙에서 유명한 호드미스 교단, 엘리트 사제들만 모였다는 불멸: I'm Father Askren of the Immortal Priesthood, an order of elite priests within Freios's renowned Hodmis Order.
Not to boast, but I became its youngest fifth-rank priest. Hahaha.
strings.말이 기네. 그게 뭐 어쨌는데?: That's a lot of words. So what?
strings.…엄청 대단한 겁니다! 이 나이에 5급이 되려면 엄청나게 고생해야 한다고: ...It's a tremendous achievement! You have to work incredibly hard to reach fifth rank at my age! (Chokes up.)
strings.(그런 그때 아스크렌의 목 위로 데스사이드의 섬뜩한 날이 다가온다.): (Just then, the chilling blade of a Death Scythe approaches Askren's neck.)
Oh? Oooooh, this is Shynic's famous Death Scythe! I've heard so much about it.
Shynic, I'll handle this. Stand back.
It looks fun. I want to hear him out.
strings.%s 님, 제가 얼마나 보고 싶어 했는지 아십니까? 그새 프레이오스를 떠: %s, do you know how much I wanted to see you? You've already left Freios and come to Eastland!
strings.정말 신출귀몰하십니다!: You truly appear and disappear without warning!
strings.…상대하기 피곤한 사람이군. 모험가와 알고 있는 사람이라면 이쯤에서 물러: ...What an exhausting person. If you know the adventurer, I'll stand down.
...He's the priest who helped me in Nidaros.
I see. Nice to meet you. I'm Medea of Kali village.
Wow. To meet the Medea and Shynic I've heard so much about!
strings.그야 교단 비밀 기록…. 아차, 죄송합니다. 비밀로 하려고 했는데 안 되: Well, the Order's secret records... Oops. Sorry. I meant to keep that secret, but apparently I can't. Think of it as fate and welcome me.
strings.재미있다기보다는 꽤 잘생기지 않았습니까?: Handsome rather than amusing, wouldn't you say?
strings.사제님은 수상합니다만, 뒤에 계신 데미갓 분을 봐서라도 이야기를 들어 보: You're suspicious, Father, but for the sake of the Demigod behind you, I'll hear you out.
Demigod, stop hiding and come down.
Frozen is very busy and couldn't join this time...
strings.(아스크렌이 손가락으로 하늘을 가리키자, 높은 나무 위에서 아래를 바라보: (Askren points upward. Someone watching from a tall tree lands lightly.)
Kali is so beautiful that I was admiring it from above. Nice to meet you all.
strings.(한 여성이 핑크빛 긴 생머리를 넘기면서 환한 미소를 지으며 눈을 맞추고: (A woman brushes back her long pink hair, meets their eyes with a bright smile, and offers %s a handshake.)
I'm Lydia. And the spirit on my shoulder is Roro. Say hello, Roro.
strings.(데미갓 리디아가 로로라고 소개한 정령의 머리를 쓰다듬는다. 그러자 로로: (Demigod Lydia strokes the head of the spirit she introduced as Roro. Roro blinks.)
strings.네가 이제껏 만난 사람들이 이야기했던 그 리디아. 데미갓 3인 중의 한: The Lydia everyone you've met has talked about. One of the three Demigods. Ah, two now.
Hello. I'm %s... I didn't expect to meet you like this.
strings.만나서 반가워. 나도 이렇게 인사할 줄은 몰랐는데, 급한 일이 생겨서 칼: Nice to meet you. I didn't expect this introduction, either, but urgent business brought me to Kali.
For a Demigod to come in person...
strings.메리멜, 베이넌, 제가 이분들을 모시고 가겠습니다. 두 사람은 하던 일을: Merimel, Beinan, I'll take our guests. Please return to your work.
Merimel, here are your new tools. Take them.
strings.메디아 님, 괜찮으시겠습니까?: Medea, will you be all right?
strings.(대체 무슨 일이기에…. 데미갓 리디아 님과 아스크렌 사제님이 왔지…?): (What could have brought Demigod Lydia and Father Askren here...?)
strings.일단 차라도 한잔하시면서 이야기를 나눌까요?: Shall we talk over a cup of tea?
strings.칼리 마을의 차가 궁금하기는 하지만, %s에게 우리가 온 목적을 이야기하: I'm curious about Kali's tea, but telling %s why we came must come first. Let's save it for later.
It feels as though you're hesitating.
strings.핑크 데미갓, 재미있는 일이야?: Pink Demigod, is it something fun?
The Order has many enjoyable duties.
Father Askren, stop talking and take out what you brought.
strings.(아스크렌이 품에서 작은 석판을 꺼내 %s의 앞에 내민다.): (Askren takes a small stone tablet from his clothes and presents it to %s.)
What is this? My name seems to be engraved on it...
strings.이리스 님이 어둠에서 돌아오신 후 회복하던 공간에 있던 신석(神石)으로: A tablet made from divine stone found in the place where Iris recovered after returning from the darkness.
When someone's name appears on it, we find that person and have them read its contents.
strings.그래서 절 찾아오셨군요…. 그럼 뭘 확인하면 되죠?: That's why you came to me... What should I check?
Only the person receiving the oracle can read this tablet.
Exactly. As the God of the Astral Realm, she has given %s her first oracle.
A message delivered in a god's name may be a command or a prophecy. That's why we need to check.
I'd like to speak with Iris first...
strings.그건 안 돼. 네가 이리스 님과 정신적으로 연결된 존재라 하더라도 신탁이: You can't. Even with your mental connection to her, once an oracle is issued, nothing else can be done.
strings.신탁의 내용이 무엇이든 끝이 나기 전까지는…. 그게 신과 인간의 관계이기: Until whatever the oracle says is complete... That's part of the relationship between gods and humans...
strings.지금으로서는 이해가 되지 않을 수도 있어. 갑자기 일어난 일이니까. 그런: It may be hard to understand. This happened so suddenly. But that's the nature of an oracle... In any case, you trust Iris, don't you?
You know she wouldn't lead you astray.
Now, %s. Put your hand on this tablet. You'll understand naturally.
And quietly recite what it says. Please.
strings.(모험가가 석판 위에 손을 올리자 알 수 없는 빛과 어둠이 교차하는 환영: (As the adventurer places a hand on the tablet, a vision of unknown light and darkness crossing unfolds before them.)
strings.(그리고 그 앞에 전과는 다른 모습으로 서 있는 한 남자의 모습이 들어온: (A man stands before them, his appearance changed from before.)
strings.………마신의 운명을 지닌 자가…… '아마란스 노바'에서 기다리고 있으니,: ...The one bearing the fate of a Demon God... waits in Amaranth Nova. Pierce his heart and destroy him...?
